The front end does not include advertising trackers or third-party visitor analytics scripts.
使用「问 RONG」的在线功能时，你提交的问题、相关对话上下文与工具结果会经 V: When you use the live Ask RONG feature, your question, relevant conversation context and tool results are sent through a proxy on Vercel to DeepSeek. Web searches may send search terms to Tavily or request public information from GitHub and other websites.

Do not submit passwords, identity documents, unpublished files or other sensitive material.
网站使用浏览器存储保存部分功能偏好、临时缓存和加载恢复标记。若你主动通过开发者功: Browser storage holds some preferences, temporary caches and load-recovery markers. If you explicitly configure a model API key through the developer feature, it is stored in this browser. Conversation content lives in the current page’s memory. Clearing this site’s browser data does not also delete server-side logs.
